title: GHA mail scan + CCR morning briefing daily schedule
desc: Daily 09:00 KST automated pipeline: GHA scans Naver IMAP + Gmail for headhunter emails and posts to GitHub daily issue; CCR remote agent reads committed news files and posts Korean morning briefing comment.
steps: GHA mail_scan.yml: cron 0 0 * * * (00:00 UTC = 09:00 KST). Needs repo secrets: NAVER_APP_PASSWORD, GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN, GH_PAT.

Naver scan in GHA: inline Python script using imaplib.IMAP4_SSL imap.naver.com:993 + NAVER_APP_PASSWORD secret. Posts headhunter hits as comments on daily-news GitHub issue via wk_issue.post_comment().
Gmail scan in GHA: inline Python script using OAuth2 refresh_token flow (no websocket, pure urllib). Fetches unread messages, keyword-filters, posts hits to same daily issue.

CCR routine (claude.ai/code/routines): cron 5 0 * * * (09:05 KST). Reads today news/YYYY-MM-DD.md from repo, posts Korean morning briefing to daily issue via gh CLI. Routine ID: trig_01Y72zJnupSkK3m4JvqjmhhQ.
daily_news.yml already runs at 0 0 * * * (09:00 KST) via GHA -- news MD committed before CCR briefing fires at 09:05.
author: claude
